name: Death Guard
note: 16 list entries, 14 units after two attachments, 49 models, 2020 pts (the supplied list says 2015; four entries disagree with the transcribed points list, which wins - see game/factions/death_guard_points.py).

roster.note: A MONSTER CHARACTER with no LEADER line - it always fights alone.
10x Plague Marines: 3 with Boltgun, 2 Plague spewer, 2 Blight launcher, 2 Heavy plague weapon; the Champion keeps the printed default and so takes no choices.
Printed default (Manreaper + plaguespurt gauntlet, no icon of despair). This one carries Typhus.

Hades battle cannon, 2x Excruciator cannon, Heavy reaper autocannon, Heavy missile launcher, Shearing claws - the reaper REPLACES the printed heavy baleflamer (the missile launcher is kept), and it is one of the two Defiler options that costs points.
Plague probe, Fleshmower - the printed default.
Two SEPARATE one-model units, not one two-model unit: the list prints them as two entries at 100 pts each, and the datasheet allows 1-2 models per unit.
Armoured tracks, Plagueburst mortar, Heavy slugger, 2x Entropy cannon - the printed default.
